targets.rawSql: WITH indoor AS (SELECT AVG(value) as temp FROM (SELECT value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/air-quality/**/*.parquet') WHERE metric IN ('atmp', 'temperature') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100)), outdoor AS (SELECT AVG(value) as temp FROM (SELECT value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/outdoor-weather/**/*.parquet') WHERE metric = 'temperature' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100)) SELECT (indoor.temp - outdoor.temp) AS "value" FROM indoor, outdoor

WITH indoor AS (SELECT AVG(value) as pm25 FROM (SELECT value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/air-quality/**/*.parquet') WHERE metric = 'pm02' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100)), outdoor AS (SELECT AVG(value) as pm25 FROM (SELECT value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/outdoor-air-quality/**/*.parquet') WHERE metric = 'pm2_5' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100)) SELECT (indoor.pm25 - outdoor.pm25) AS "value" FROM indoor, outdoor

WITH indoor AS (SELECT AVG(value) as humidity FROM (SELECT value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/air-quality/**/*.parquet') WHERE metric IN ('rhum', 'humidity') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100)), outdoor AS (SELECT AVG(value) as humidity FROM (SELECT value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/outdoor-weather/**/*.parquet') WHERE metric = 'humidity' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100)) SELECT (indoor.humidity - outdoor.humidity) AS "value" FROM indoor, outdoor

WITH indoor AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as bucket, AVG(CASE WHEN metric IN ('atmp', 'temperature') THEN value END) as temp FROM read_parquet('/data/data/air-quality/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1), outdoor AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as bucket, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'temperature' THEN value END) as temp FROM read_parquet('/data/data/outdoor-weather/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(i.bucket, o.bucket) as time, i.temp as "Indoor Temperature", o.temp as "Outdoor Temperature" FROM indoor i FULL OUTER JOIN outdoor o ON i.bucket = o.bucket ORDER BY time

WITH indoor AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as bucket, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'pm02' THEN value END) as pm25 FROM read_parquet('/data/data/air-quality/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1), outdoor AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as bucket, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'pm2_5' THEN value END) as pm25 FROM read_parquet('/data/data/outdoor-air-quality/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(i.bucket, o.bucket) as time, i.pm25 as "Indoor PM2.5", o.pm25 as "Outdoor PM2.5" FROM indoor i FULL OUTER JOIN outdoor o ON i.bucket = o.bucket ORDER BY time

WITH indoor AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as bucket, AVG(CASE WHEN metric IN ('rhum', 'humidity') THEN value END) as humidity FROM read_parquet('/data/data/air-quality/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1), outdoor AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as bucket, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'humidity' THEN value END) as humidity FROM read_parquet('/data/data/outdoor-weather/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(i.bucket, o.bucket) as time, i.humidity as "Indoor Humidity", o.humidity as "Outdoor Humidity" FROM indoor i FULL OUTER JOIN outdoor o ON i.bucket = o.bucket ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as time, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'rco2' THEN value END) as "CO2 (ppm)" FROM read_parquet('/data/data/air-quality/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
